registry_mirrors.description: List of registry mirror URLs (e.g., https://mirror.gcr.io) to try before the default Docker Hub.

insecure_registries.description: List of registry hostnames (and optionally ports) to allow insecure HTTP or TLS with unverified certificates.

default_runtime.description: Name of the default container runtime to use (e.g., runc, nvidia).

runtimes.description: Additional container runtimes with custom configurations.

name.description: Unique name for the runtime (e.g., nvidia).

runtimeArgs.description: List of additional arguments passed to the runtime binary.

storage_driver.description: Storage driver to use for images and containers (e.g., overlay2, vfs, zfs).

live_restore.description: Whether to keep containers running when the Docker daemon stops or restarts.

userland_proxy.description: Whether to use Docker's userland proxy for port mapping (required for some edge cases).

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 networking support (required for IPv6 container addressing).

fixed_cidr_v6.description: IPv6 subnet for container allocation when IPv6 is enabled.

dns.description: List of DNS server IP addresses to configure inside containers.

dns_search.description: List of DNS search domains to configure inside containers.

labels.description: List of labels describing node or host characteristics (e.g., ['node=worker1', 'disk=ssd']).

log_driver.description: Default logging driver for containers (e.g., json-file, syslog, journald).

log_opts.description: Logging driver options as key=value pairs (e.g., ['max-size=10m', 'max-file=5']).

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of concurrent downloads per image pull (higher = faster pulls but more network use).

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of concurrent uploads per image push.

Name.description: Name of the ulimit (e.g., nofile, nproc).

features.description: Feature flags to enable experimental containerd features.

max_concurrent_updates.description: Maximum number of concurrent image update operations (e.g., for Swarm updates).

max_containers.description: Maximum number of containers allowed to run simultaneously (0 = unlimited).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

data_root.description: Root directory for Docker persistent data (images, volumes, etc.).

exec_root.description: Root directory for exec-related temporary files.

pidfile.description: Path to the Docker daemon PID file.

containerd.description: Path to the containerd socket (typically auto-detected).

bip.description: Bridge IP address and CIDR (e.g., 172.17.0.1/16) for the default docker0 bridge network.

fixed_cidr.description: IPv4 subnet for Docker-assigned container IPs when using the default bridge.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for the default bridge network.

default_gateway.description: IPv4 default gateway for containers on the default bridge.

default_gateway_v6.description: IPv6 default gateway for containers on the default bridge.

bridge.description: Name of the default bridge interface (use 'none' to disable bridge networking).
